full_judgment: 2. Short facts of the case are that on a First Information Report lodged by the com-plainant opposite party No. 2, Abul Hossain Sarkar G.R. Case No. 364 of 1983 under sections 143/448080 of the Penal Code was started on the allegation that on the night following 2. 10.83 at 2-30 A. M.15/16 persons, entered his house and beat his son with lathi ; that when they entered into the room of the informant he fled away from his room and while fleeing he recognised accused petitioners 0 Kadam Ali, 2) Bashiruddin and 3) Solernan near the gate of his house ; that the accused persons looted away valuable articles worth Tk. 351 51- . Police investigated the case and submitted charge sheet against the accused petitioners under section 147/448/380 of the Penal Code. The learned Sub Divisional Magistrate, Thakurgaon, transferred the case to the Upazila Magistrate, Pirganj for trial. The learned Upazilla Magistrate then issued notices to the witnesses and fixed a date for taking further steps. On that date the informant filed an application for further enquiry of the case. Thereafter the learned Magistrate ordered for a fresh enquiry and report by another Magistrate, On getting enquiry report the learned Upazilla Magistrate found that enquiry report varied from the charge sheet and so he fixed 2.8.84 for recording the evidence of witnesses by his order dated 18.4.84 and thereafter the learned Magistrate took cognizance of the case under sections 147/448/395 of the Penal Code, instead of section 147/4461380 as stated in the charge sheet by his order dated 6 8 84.
